_readme: Young Women class tabs (orgs/young-women/). Rendered in the browser by orgs/young-women/classes.js, so page rebuilds keep it. classes: id (URL hash), name, presidency [{role,name}], advisers [names], members [other girls in the class, not in the presidency; alphabetical, first name + last initial], info (one short line). Leave a field null/empty to show 'Coming soon'. NO phone numbers or other personal info for youth. activities: one object per item with class = a class id or 'all' (shows in every class tab); title, date (YYYY-MM-DD), endDate (optional), time, place, details, flyer (path from site root, e.g. 'events/flyers/x.jpg'), link (optional https URL). Items hide after their date/endDate (America/Denver). all: ward-wide leaders shown on the All Young Women tab (adults: full names; presidency names already in the page's contact card are not repeated) plus handbook notes. YOUTH: FIRST NAMES ONLY; you may store a last initial (e.g. 'Emma H.'). The page shows the initial only when two girls' first names are alike (e.g. 'Brynnlee B.' and 'Brinley R.'); otherwise it shows the first name alone.

points.t: The Young Women organization helps young women make and keep sacred covenants and deepen their conversion to Jesus Christ and His gospel.
“I am a beloved daughter of heavenly parents, with a divine nature and eternal destiny. …” The theme helps each young woman understand her divine identity and become converted to Jesus Christ.

Each class has a called president, and where possible counselors and a secretary. Class presidencies, supported by adult leaders, plan Sunday meetings, service, and activities. Advisers support and guide class presidencies as they learn and carry out their responsibilities.
